mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMENT ( POST_SN, CMNT_CN, CMNT_WRTR_SN, CMNT_FRST_WRT_DT, DEL_YN, PARENT_CMNT_SN ) VALUES ( #{postSn}, #{cmntCn}, #{cmntWrtrSn}, #{cmntFrstWrtDt}, #{delYn}, #{parentCmntSn} )
mapper.select: SELECT CMNT_SN, POST_SN, CMNT_CN, CMNT_WRTR_SN, CMNT_FRST_WRT_DT, CMNT_LAST_MDFCN_DT, DEL_YN, PARENT_CMNT_SN FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE CMNT_SN = #{cmntSn}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COMMENT SET DEL_YN = TRUE, CMNT_LAST_MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE CMNT_SN = #{cmntSn}
mapper.select: SELECT CMNT_SN, POST_SN, CMNT_CN, CMNT_WRTR_SN, CMNT_FRST_WRT_DT, CMNT_LAST_MDFCN_DT, DEL_YN, PARENT_CMNT_SN FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE PARENT_CMNT_SN = #{parentCmntSn} AND DEL_YN = FALSE ORDER BY CMNT_SN ASC
